_doc: M3 batch 2: LTX-2.3 image-to-video from the picked keyframes (scripts/clips.py, ComfyUI template video_ltx2_3_i2v, converted with scripts/comfy_ui_to_api.mjs). Prompt = motion + the brief's shared clip style. 4 s at 24 fps, 960x720 (4:3; the template's two-stage half-res + 2x upscale). Two seeds per clip. Picks go in 'kept' as {clip: path}.
style: 1920s black-and-white newsreel footage, static camera, period clothing, soft light, smooth motion, no text, no logos

C1a.motion: the couples dance the Charleston energetically, kicking their heels and swinging their arms in time, skirts swirling

C1b.motion: the couples on the floor dance the Charleston, kicking heels in unison, the band plays on the stage behind them

C2.motion: long strips of paper ticker tape stream and flutter down from the ceiling onto the dancers, who keep dancing

C3.motion: one hand passes the crumpled banknote to the other hand, which closes around it and pulls away

S23band.motion: the clarinet player and the trumpet player take turns playing hot jazz breaks, swaying and bobbing their instruments up and down, tapping their feet, the one not playing nods along

S23kick.motion: the six dancers dance the Charleston in unison, swiveling their feet, kicking their legs high and swinging their arms, their fringe swinging

S28run.motion: the crowd runs fast from left to right across the screen in a panic, arms pumping, coats flapping, hats bobbing

_kept_status: provisional (agent's suggestion, 2026-10-31), for the human to confirm in the M4 animatic

style_sets.shadowplay: shadow theater, pure solid black silhouettes against an evenly backlit plain white paper screen, static camera, smooth motion, no text
